name: Extremal-Extension VC Dimension of Singletons
proof: For $n=1$, the class itself has one concept and exactly one shattered set, the empty set; it is extremal of VC dimension zero. For $n\ge2$, the original class shatters a coordinate, so every extension has VC dimension at least one. Adding the empty concept gives $n+1$ concepts with exactly the empty set and the $n$ singletons shattered, hence an extremal extension of VC dimension one.
